races.name: Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
Plenty of these look longer-term projects but CHOCTAW NATION shaped promisingly behind one who set a tall standard for a maiden on debut at Navan 25 days ago. Beating the rest handsomely himself on that occasion, he's clearly another above-average Ballydoyle colt and rates the one to beat with improvement forthcoming. Book of Kells and State of Play are a couple of likely newcomers before betting clues, with Cracks and Sparks and Adversity completing the shortlist.

  1. CHOCTAW NATION (IRE)
  2. BOOK OF KELLS (IRE)
  3. STATE OF PLAY (FR)

races.name: Mongey Communications Sprint Handicap
races.verdict:
GAZELLE D'OR is very well weighted these days and with the expectation of this being a good test by 5f standards, she could be the answer. Stag Night arrives at the very top of his game so he's an obvious threat, with Gerrit's Gem also of some interest.

  1. GAZELLE D'OR (IRE)
  2. STAG NIGHT (IRE)
  3. GERRIT'S GEM (IRE)

races.name: Ryans Cleaning Race
races.verdict:
EXCELLENT BELIEVE can cement his positive start for the Stephen Thorne stable by getting his head back in front here. Unique Journey is the obvious threat after his smart effort to win a 6f course handicap last month. Best of the rest may be Storm Ready, who has quickly reached a useful level when winning both starts this autumn.

  1. EXCELLENT BELIEVE
  2. UNIQUE JOURNEY (IRE)
  3. STORM READY (IRE)

races.name: Isuzu Ireland Handicap
races.verdict:
A wide-open handicap that may go the way of LADY MARY HEATH, who looked to have plenty up her sleeve when winning at Punchestown on Thursday. Therewillbeglory and Spacebound are a couple of obvious dangers, with Loingseoir and Thru and Thru lurking on potentially dangerous marks.

  1. LADY MARY HEATH (IRE)
  2. THEREWILLBEGLORY (IRE)
  3. SPACEBOUND

races.name: QuinnBet Loughbrown Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
Last year's winner CHALLY CHUTE wasn't at his best at Saint-Cloud last week but had posted a borderline smart performance when landing the Irish Cesarewitch here previously and is fancied to take this prize home again. Amelia Earhart and Asakir are feared most.

  1. CHALLY CHUTE (IRE)
  2. AMELIA EARHART (IRE)
  3. ASAKIR (IRE)

races.name: Keadeen Hotel Premier Handicap
races.verdict:
Ultra competitive with the tentative vote going to INVINCIBLE WILL, who looks on a good mark back in a handicap. Fellow 3-y-os Iamimmaculate, Expert Dancer and Uncle Goalie are on the shortlist, with Diego el Queso and Majestic King making most appeal of the older brigade.

  1. INVINCIBLE WILL (IRE)
  2. IAMIMMACULATE (IRE)
  3. EXPERT DANCER

races.name: Velo Coffee At The Curragh Maiden
races.verdict:
LOOSEN AND LIMBER stepped up markedly on her first run when third over C&D 12 days ago and she gets the vote in a winnable maiden. Joe Cool and Purple Bandit are others to consider.

  1. LOOSEN AND LIMBER
  2. JOE COOL (IRE)
  3. PURPLE BANDIT (IRE)

races.name: QuinnBet Finale Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
THREAD OF GOLD confirmed the improvement he showed in handicaps when posting a good fifth in a Leopardstown Group 3 a couple of months ago, that despite not being seen to best effect. He looks a big player tackling listed company for the first time and shades preference over low-mileage, improving pair The Austrian and Golden Splendour. Contorsion and In My Teens also command respect in an interesting finale.

  1. THREAD OF GOLD (IRE)
  2. THE AUSTRIAN (IRE)
  3. GOLDEN SPLENDOUR

races.name: PricedUp Bet Gordon Richards Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This has been won by some really good sorts in past years and FISHERY LANE looks another likely sort starting out for Dan Skelton having shown plenty of promise over fences for Willie Mullins last season. Walking On A Dream could emerge as the main danger ahead of Kahavari and Patrick's Wells.

  1. FISHERY LANE (FR)
  2. WALKING ON A DREAM (IRE)
  3. KAHAVARI (FR)

races.name: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Guaranteed Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KEOPS DES BORDES is in top hands and showed he retained his ability when returning from a long absence at Ayr in the spring. He can make a winning hurdling debut. Ronnie Russet and Ocean Master may provide the chief threat.

  1. KEOPS DES BORDES (FR)
  2. RONNIE RUSSET
  3. OCEAN MASTER (IRE)

races.name: PricedUp Boosted Prices Daily Houghton Mares' Chase (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Last year's winner PAGGANE arrives in top form after victory on the Flat and can repeat the feat. Apple Away is the clear danger for all this trip is on the short side for her.

  1. PAGGANE
  2. APPLE AWAY (IRE)
  3. OBSESSEDWITHYOU (FR)

races.name: PricedUp BOG From 10am Castletown Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Useful handicapper KAMSINAS has an excellent record fresh, and he gets the nod over last season's Morebattle third Wise Eagle. Dual course winner To Chase A Dream looks interesting if ready to roll, while Perseus Way has to be respected following his recent second in the Silver Trophy.

  1. KAMSINAS (FR)
  2. WISE EAGLE (IRE)
  3. TO CHASE A DREAM

races.name: Colin Parker Memorial Intermediate Chase (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Dan Skelton is really starting to get rolling and his DOYEN QUEST is fancied to make a winning return to action and cement what was a solid first season over the larger obstacles. Potters Charm was made to work hard to justify prohibitive odds on his recent return/chasing debut, but he shades the vote for the forecast spot with improvement on the cards.

  1. DOYEN QUEST (IRE)
  2. POTTERS CHARM (IRE)
  3. WENDIGO (FR)

races.name: PricedUp Boosts And BOG Cumberland Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
With the Twiston-Davies stable in form it's worth taking a chance that GUARD THE MOON, who has a good record fresh, is on a going day on his reappearance. Caughtinyourtrance has developed into a likeable and consistent handicap chaser in the first half of this season and is second choice ahead of Grand Geste, a fine second on this card on last season's reappearance.

  1. GUARD THE MOON
  2. CAUGHTINYOURTRANCE (IRE)
  3. GRAND GESTE (IRE)

races.name: PricedUp Bet Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MEETMEBYTHELAKE boasts the best point form and he's fancied to make a winning Rules debut for the Skelton team. Fellow point winner Soldiers Trick and the O'Neill-trained Business Class are next on the shortlist in a race where the only runner with prior bumper experience sets a very low standard.

  1. MEETMEBYTHELAKE (IRE)
  2. SOLDIERS TRICK (IRE)
  3. BUSINESS CLASS (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Claiming Hurdle
races.verdict:
Hardly an appealing betting race. PIGEON HOUSE should have too much speed for Shallow River, who looks the main danger at the weights. Blackwater Lilly shouldn't be dismissed in a race of unreliable types.

  1. PIGEON HOUSE (IRE)
  2. SHALLOW RIVER (IRE)
  3. BLACKWATER LILLY

races.name: CopyBet For Football Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BANKATARY proved too keen on his recent hurdling bow at Plumpton but has some fair Flat/winning bumper form to his name and the fitting of a first-time hood could prove very beneficial for this headstrong sort. Jamie Snowden's Irish recruit Code Name Cubitt returns from an absence but could still emerge as the main danger, although Charlie Fellowes' fairly useful Flat scorer Lightning Tiger brings some potential to this sphere.

  1. BANKATARY (FR)
  2. CODE NAME CUBITT (IRE)
  3. LIGHTNING TIGER (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Proudly Backs UK Horse Racing Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BROADWAY HONEY has upped her game since sent chasing and is hard to get away from here. Samuel Spade may prove most dangerous, particularly if minimising the jumping errors.

  1. BROADWAY HONEY (IRE)
  2. SAMUEL SPADE (GER)
  3. BACK IT UP (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This can go to LITTLE LADY ROCK, who is going the right way over hurdles and only found a promising debutant too good at Chepstow last time. Hereford winner Blue Topaz is the forecast pick.

  1. LITTLE LADY ROCK (IRE)
  2. BLUE TOPAZ
  3. MOYANNA

races.name: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Macer Gifford Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
IRISH CHORUS did well over fences last season and still looks favourably treated assuming she's ready to roll after 6 months off. Park Annonciade should be spot on for this with a run under his belt and is second choice ahead of Ben Pauling's Jimbo Sport, who is very much the unknown quantity in the line-up.

  1. IRISH CHORUS
  2. PARK ANNONCIADE (FR)
  3. JIMBO SPORT (FR)

races.name: CopyBet BOG Now For Racing Tomorrow Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Recent Market Rasen winner UPTON'S MIGHTY OAK looks the percentage call ahead of the returning Just A Heartbeat, who'll probably get her head in front sooner rather than later.

  1. UPTON'S MIGHTY OAK
  2. JUST A HEARTBEAT
  3. NALA THE LIONESS

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
QUICK OF THE NIGHT returned to winning ways in good style at Market Rasen last time and, from what remains a handy mark, she is taken to follow up. Camshaft had been going the right way prior to her latest outing, so could bounce back returning with her yard going well. Simiyann completes the shortlist.

  1. QUICK OF THE NIGHT
  2. CAMSHAFT (IRE)
  3. SIMIYANN (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for MOSSY FEN COOLIO, who looks on a good opening mark for his first crack at chasing and hails from a yard in flying form. Jukebox King, Grand Garcon and In The Age make up the shortlist in what should prove a highly informative opener.

  1. MOSSY FEN COOLIO
  2. JUKEBOX KING (IRE)
  3. GRAND GARCON

races.name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There's a feeling at least one of the several unexposed sorts in this line-up will come to the fore, with Olly Murphy's KINGS CHAMPION top of the list. Dan Skelton pair Saracen Beau (a new recruit for the stable) and Broomfield Aderra appeal as likely improvers on their second chase starts. The Dog Thief and High Tea are other interesting additions to the chase ranks.

  1. KINGS CHAMPION (FR)
  2. SARACEN BEAU (IRE)
  3. BROOMFIELD ADERRA (IRE)

races.name: FBC Manby Bowdler 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JOHNNY'S JURY ideally wants more of a stamina test than this but he's the class act on hurdles form so he's taken to get away with it on chase bow. Crest of Fortune was mostly overfaced over fences last season and his chase experience makes him a big threat.

  1. JOHNNY'S JURY (IRE)
  2. CREST OF FORTUNE
  3. DALSTON LAD (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RED OAK signed off his novice hurdling campaign with a decisive success at Hexham and he can continue to go the right way now tackling fences. Next Twist is surely better than he was able to show on his chase debut and remains with potential after a summer break, whilst Tigers Moon progressed over the smaller obstacles last season and is also respected.

  1. RED OAK (IRE)
  2. NEXT TWIST (FR)
  3. TIGERS MOON

races.name: PJ Nicholls KGM Korea Genuinely Made Fillies' Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SONG OF THE STARS shaped well starting out for Harry Derham when a clear second on her recent hurdling debut over C&D and this winning Flat stayer can build on it and get off the mark in this sphere here. Hurdling newcomer Red Moon, a fair Flat scorer in France, appeals as the one to chase her home ahead of Miss Moffett.

  1. SONG OF THE STARS
  2. RED MOON (FR)
  3. MISS MOFFETT

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Plenty in with chances but HIDDEN MOUNTAIN's bumper form reads well and with his yard renowned for having them spot on in the autumn, he's afforded the vote to make a successful hurdling debut. Big John Ollie looks the pick of Dan Skelton's trio, so could be the one to provide most resistance, with Beau Speed and Pride Hill another couple worth considering, as well.

  1. HIDDEN MOUNTAIN
  2. BIG JOHN OLLIE (IRE)
  3. BEAU SPEED (FR)

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
THEATRE TOM looked set to go close before departing here last time, and he's taken to gain compensation on first start over 3m. The main danger is likely to be I Love You Sivola, who has made an excellent start for his present yard. Eskimo Sam and Locked Down Lad also need considering in a competitive finale.

  1. THEATRE TOM (IRE)
  2. I LOVE YOU SIVOLA (FR)
  3. ESKIMO SAM

races.name: Paddy Power From The Horse's Mouth Podcast Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Preference is for MARCO DU SEUIL, who should be straighter for last month's Limerick return and remains open to improvement. Mailloche and Sierrascope may provide the chief threat.

  1. MARCO DU SEUIL (FR)
  2. MAILLOCHE (FR)
  3. SIERRASCOPE

races.name: Paddy Power 'Did You Watch The Breeders Cup At All?' Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
LENNON GROVE will have derived plenty from her opening hurdling run and given her bumper form, there should be plenty more to come in this sphere. Cornelienne and I Dont Really Care head the opposition.

  1. LENNON GROVE (IRE)
  2. CORNELIENNE (IRE)
  3. I DONT REALLY CARE (IRE)

races.name: Paddy Power 'I Still Call It Twitter' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WEST AWAY has made a superb start for his new yard over fences and from a very fair mark back hurdling, he looks the answer. Who's Da Goose could do with brushing up his jumping but he is a definite threat, while an improved showing from handicap debutant Man Down would come as no surprise.

  1. WEST AWAY (IRE)
  2. WHO'S DA GOOSE
  3. MAN DOWN (IRE)

races.name: Paddy Power 'How Many Days 'Til Christmas' Irish EBF Novice Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict:
Stepping up to 3m for the first time, THE FLYINGKING may be able to get the job done in spite of his quirks. Minella Emperor's proven stamina gives him the edge over Roc Dino in the next-best vote.

  1. THEFLYINGKING (IRE)
  2. MINELLA EMPEROR (IRE)
  3. ROC DINO (FR)

races.name: Paddy Power Betting Shops Irish EBF Novice Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
LOVE ME TENDER and Vicar Street may well lead home a 1-2 for powerful connections in an interesting renewal. Last season's Albert Bartlett runner-up Fruit De Mer looks potentially dangerous on his chasing debut.

  1. LOVE ME TENDER (FR)
  2. VICAR STREET (IRE)
  3. FRUIT DE MER (IRE)

races.name: Paddy Power Cork Grand National Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
FOU DE TOI hasn't looked back since sent over fences and with this longer trip also a likely plus he is fancied to complete a quick hat-trick. Both Our Soldier and Quantum Quest have also been shaping as though this marathon distance will show them in a much better light though and should ensure Willie Mullins' upwardly-mobile young chaser doesn't have things all his own way in this intriguing handicap.

  1. FOU DE TOI (FR)
  2. OUR SOLDIER (IRE)
  3. QUANTUM QUEST (IRE)

races.name: Ballymaloe Foods Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
COLIN'S FRIEND left the impression a race of this nature was his for the taking when a close third at Killarney last month and makes plenty of appeal. Nukie's Artic, Duce Bigalow and Polly Poppins complete the shortlist.

  1. COLIN'S FRIEND (IRE)
  2. NUKIE'S ARTIC (IRE)
  3. DUCE BIGALOW (IRE)

races.name: The Hong Kong College Of Emergency Medicine 30th Anniversary Cup (Handicap)
French Arabian Breeders' Challenge Classic - Wathba Stallions (arab Group 1)
